summary: Gone tower listed at Kelly Knob, Craig County; the Appalachian Trail overlook there is a public day hike, and no source describes a tower remaining.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone in the Virginia lookout list; no source describes remains at the site.

access.note: A trail guide describes a day hike for families or groups on the Appalachian Trail in Jefferson National Forest. The guide does not describe a tower.

evidence.supports: Kelly Knob tower in Craig County at the listed coordinates, marked gone
Kelly's Knob is a rocky overlook on the Appalachian Trail
evidence.quote: Hike a segment of the Appalachian Trail to a Kelly's Knob, a rocky overlook looking over the valley below.

evidence.supports: Directions along State Route 601, also called Clover Hollow Road, to the trailhead
evidence.quote: From 460W Take Blue Grass Trail Rd then a left onto Clover Hollow Rd/State Route 601

evidence.supports: The trailhead is on the right, at the Appalachian Trail intersection on State Route 601
evidence.quote: the trailhead is on the right

evidence.supports: A sign and blue trail markers lead to the lookout
evidence.quote: leading to the lookout is seen on the right

evidence.supports: Top of the hike has a firepit and rocky outlooks
evidence.quote: There's a firepit and several rocky outlooks to explore and take pictures of.

evidence.supports: Day hike for families or groups on the Appalachian Trail in Jefferson National Forest
evidence.quote: This is a great day hike for families or groups looking to get out for a short hike on the Appalachian Trail in Jefferson National Forest.

sources.title: Kelly's Knob via the Appalachian Trail, Craig County, Virginia

notes_for_editor: Directory-only tower record. The trail guide mentions a sign to 'the lookout' but describes only rocky outlooks and a firepit; it is not evidence of a tower, and the story says so. The directory coordinates are not matched to a location in the guide, which gives none. A search summary said the directory has no Kelly's Knob entry; the cached directory does list Kelly Knob (Craig, 37.35592, -80.44091, Tower, Gone), so the summary was wrong. No construction, staffing or removal source found. Access level 'public' rests on the guide's description of an AT day hike in the national forest, not on any statement about the tower site.
